query: SELECT e.lifecycle_status,i.status AS incident_status,p.attendance_status,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.contribution_events c WHERE c.cleanup_event_id=e.id AND c.user_id=$2) AS rewards,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.event_evidence x WHERE x.cleanup_event_id=e.id AND x.type='AFTER') AS after_photos,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.notifications n WHERE n.user_id=$2 AND n.type='EVENT_COMPLETED' AND n.data->>'eventId'=e.id::text) AS notifications FROM public.cleanup_events e JOIN public.incidents i ON i.id=e.incident_id JOIN public.event_participants p ON p.cleanup_event_id=e.id AND p.user_id=$2 WHERE e.id=$1
